While individual social relationship assets and personal support networks qualify as Socioeconomic_factors, external welfare subsidies, paid or unpaid caregiver services, and institutional health/social service programs must be classified as Non-LSF (O).

triad.description: Both BERT and the Generator misclassified standalone plain water consumption as Nutrition instead of filtering it as Non-LSF (O).

guidebook.guideline: Distinguish dietary nutritional intake and specialized nutrient-bearing beverages from generic hydration and plain water consumption. Mentions of plain water or uncharacterized fluid intake without specific nutritional, caloric, or micronutrient formulations belong to Non-LSF (O) rather than Nutrition.

triad.description: The Generator erroneously rejected an educational status candidate as a generic demographic cohort descriptor, failing to confirm BERT's correct Socioeconomic_factors prediction.

guidebook.guideline: Distinguish compound subject or population descriptors containing explicit educational enrollment, academic level, or occupational status (e.g., 'college students', 'female college students', 'university graduates', 'employed women') from standalone demographic markers (e.g., 'females', 'men', 'adults'). When candidate spans incorporate formal educational attainment or employment status, classify them under Socioeconomic_factors rather than rejecting them as demographic exclusions.

triad.description: The Generator erroneously rejected an anchored socioeconomic indicator candidate ('SES indicators') as Non-LSF, treating a valid domain-anchored metric as an abstract methodological variable.

guidebook.guideline: Distinguish compound metric, index, or indicator terms anchored to explicit lifestyle or socioeconomic determinants (e.g., 'SES indicators', 'dietary quality score', 'physical activity index') from isolated, unanchored study design or methodological variable headers. When a candidate span combines a measurement descriptor with a definitive lifestyle or socioeconomic concept, classify it under the anchored lifestyle category rather than rejecting it as Non-LSF (O).
